full_judgment: 2. Petitioner of Civil Revision No. 9371 of 1991 as plaintiff filed the aforesaid Title Suit No. 485 of 1984 against opposite party No. 1 Asabullah, his son opposite party No. 2 Kurfan Ullah and others for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the suit land on the allegation that suit land originally belonged to Kunja Mohan Chakraborty who made a will in favour of the plaintiff and the plaintiff got the will probated and had been possessing the suit land cultivating paddy therein. His further case is, that defendant No. 1 obtained a decree for perpetual injunction against the plaintiff in Title Suit No. 148 of 1974 and thereafter he filed Miscellaneous Case No. 146 of 1973 for correction of the SA Khatian and though the said case was dismissed defendant dispossessed the plaintiff on 25th Sraban, 1390 BS.
